description: Unite and Fight (Guild Wars) Nightmare 95 Dark 1-turn burst optimization catalog built around Yatima Quick Call (Death Lv200 + Versusia Lv150 -> Nier Lv100), Ereshkigal Lv250, Yukata Ilsa, Seox Lv150, and Halloween Ewiyar.

honorsBreakdown.singleTurnSkipNote: Killing Demeter cleanly in Turn 1 skips all 75%, 50%, and 25% HP triggers (zero boss buffs/dispel needed).

yatimaEngine.quickCallRule: Yatima (Home at Last) cuts skill CDs by 1T and calls 2 eligible equipped summons. With Summer Belial and regular Belial both excluded from Yatima's call pool, Quick Call deterministically triggers Death Lv200 + Versusia Lv150 in 1 button 100% of runs.
yatimaEngine.zeroCallDamageRule: Yatima verbatim: 'Activated calls don't deal call DMG / Excludes sub aura summons and one-use calls.' Direct nuke summons like Bahamut deal 0 call damage when invoked through Yatima or sitting in Sub-Aura slots.
excludedNonCallablePool: Summer Belial Lv40 (1273519543, 2040411000 - one-use call: Dodge/Tank-and-Counter + 2k supp taken at battle start)
Belial Lv150 (933713546, 2040347000 - one-use call: +30,000 Supplemental DMG per hit / -30% Max HP)
causalityChain: 1. Yatima Quick Call invokes Death Lv200 + Versusia Lv150 simultaneously.
2. Death (Deathly Thirteen) executes Slot 3 Ewiyar (Halloween), grants party 4T Guaranteed TA, and swaps Backline Slot 4 Nier (Lv100) into frontline Slot 3.
3. Nier entry triggers 'The Lovers Upright +' (unlocking C4S4 Eternal Vow) and grants Thirsting (Autorevive + 15% Absorption).
4. Ally KO triggers Yukata Ilsa Passive 2 'Diuturna' (1 -> 2 stacks + resets cooldowns), unlocking Triple Strike on C2S3 'Diva Satanica'.
5. Ally KO triggers Pain of Death Lv200 'Lovers-Death's Demise' (+15% Unique Stackable ATK & DEF to all Dark allies).
6. Versusia (Yomotsu) grants party 'Wild Flurry (1 time)' (+1 normal attack hit count on every ally's first swing) and grants MC 'Celestial Dominion'.

7. Ereshkigal (Tell Ibrahim II) starts MC at 100% charge bar. On Attack, MC C.A.s FIRST ('Eklu Kurnugia +'), granting all allies Double Strike + 50,000 Normal Attack Supplemental DMG AND immediately consuming Celestial Dominion (2.60M nuke + +20% DMG Taken Amplified debuff for 1T) BEFORE Ilsa, Seox, and Nier swing.

subAuraAnalysis.notes: Replaces Beelzebub Lv150 in Sub-Aura 1 without affecting Yatima's Death+Versusia pool; adds ~10M free player-phase damage across Ilsa, Seox, Nier, and MC.

subAuraAnalysis.turn1Value: +10% boost to Dark's, Hatred's, and Oblivion's weapon skills
subAuraAnalysis.notes: Best Sub-Aura 2 currently owned because Hades is Lv200 evo 5 (sub-aura unlocks at Transcendence Lv210+) and Bahamut Lv250 gives 0% value under 1T Yatima.

subAuraAnalysis.turn1Value: When MC uses a C.A.: Raise MC Trance lvl +1 (Max 2 in 1T; Sharp boost requires Trance 3)
subAuraAnalysis.notes: In a 1-turn Ereshkigal burst, MC only performs 1 C.A. (or 2 with Last Love), reaching at most Trance lvl 2. Trance lvl 3 (50% Perp ATK / 20% Cap) never activates.
Activated Yatima sub-summon calls deal 0 direct call damage, so Bahamut's +50% call DMG and -1T CD cut provide zero Turn-1 damage.

subAuraAnalysis.turn1Value: Friend Hades Lv250 provides +170% Optimus aura + 30% Dark ATK; owned Hades Lv200 has no sub_aura.
subAuraAnalysis.notes: Owned Hades Lv200 lacks Transcendence sub-aura and is callable if placed in Sub 2-5, which would pollute Yatima's Death+Versusia lock.

characterAndSkillRoi.skillName: Yatima Quick Call (Death Lv200 + Versusia Lv150) + F5 Reload
characterAndSkillRoi.notes: Enables Nier switch-in (The Lovers Upright -> Eternal Vow), Ilsa Diuturna 1->2, Pain of Death +15% Perp ATK, 4T TA, Wild Flurry (+9.9M), and Celestial Dominion (+2.6M + 20% Amp).
Highest single-button DPS gain in the party! Death killing Ewiyar raises Diuturna from 1 -> 2, turning Diva Satanica into Triple Strike (3x 3-hit autos). Same drawer as C2S1.
Grants field +30% Bonus Dark DMG (Echo) and +20% ATK across all 4 attackers' multi-hit normal swings.
Grants party 100%/20% Crit, +15% DMG Cap Up, and +20% Bonus Dark DMG (Echo) for 5 turns.
Grants Seox +60% Normal Attack DMG Amplified and +60% Bonus Dark DMG (42.7M Double Strike damage on Turn 1).
Shares Nier's already-open drawer after C4S1 (no extra open-drawer tap): adds Perpetuity ATK + two 6-hit post-attack Dark nukes (8.06M+).
Deals 2.22M skill nuke + inflicts 30,000 Supplemental DMG Taken debuff (~5.85M across ~195 hits) and +375 honor. Keep as safe buffer until Opus Beta / Sariel push 5-Skill over 135M.
Targeted character popup adds ~2.5s extra latency (4.74s total) and adds C.A. lockout penalty, yielding only ~1.79 M/sec vs C2S3 Diva Satanica's ~8.67 M/sec.
Heavenly Howl starts at lvl 3 and needs lvl 6 for Double Strike, so C3S2 gives 0 Double Strike and 0 player-phase damage on Turn 1. Replace with C2S3.
